Use this ISSUE_TEMPLATE to standardize bug/data-quality reports.

Instructions for this file:
1) Include a concise Summary describing expected vs observed behavior.
2) Provide Steps to reproduce with exact commands/queries and sample data if possible.
3) Add Data / Environment details (dataset/table, branch/environment, time window).
4) Include Logs / error messages and any screenshots or attachments.
5) Add Impact and Priority so the triage team can prioritize.

When filing issues, link to relevant pipeline run IDs, file names in the bronze stage, and any failing DQ checks.
